failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: All three coordinator queries are near-identical: Hop 2 asks 'What Spanish operas were staged or directed by Bodo Igesz, and how many acts do they have?'; Hop 3 asks 'Which Spanish opera did Bodo Igesz stage, and how many acts does it have?' Both queries target the same information (Spanish opera + Bodo Igesz + act count) with only minor wording changes. All three hops return the same Bodo Igesz passage listing Cardillac, Die Jakobsleiter, The Bassarids, and Melusine—none of which are Spanish operas.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: In hop 3, the retrieval returns 10 documents, most completely irrelevant to the claim (Psychological egoism, Human behaviour genetics, Integer points in convex polyhedra, Me TV, Bodo nationalism, Languages of the United States, How to Survive a Plague). Yet the solver does not call out this degradation in retrieval quality or filter these passages; instead the system concatenates all retrieved documents into final output without analysis of their relevance.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Solver summary 1 explicitly names the missing evidence: 'Critical missing evidence: - A passage identifying a Spanish opera staged by Bodo Igesz'. Coordinator hop 2 query targets this gap: 'What Spanish operas were staged or directed by Bodo Igesz'. Hop 3 query similarly targets it: 'Which Spanish opera did Bodo Igesz stage'. Despite two well-formed queries chasing the explicitly-named missing entity (a Spanish opera staged by Igesz), no such passage ever arrives—the Bodo Igesz passage repeats across all three hops listing only German/Austrian operas.

failure_modes.name: Evidence_Present_But_Missed
failure_modes.evidence: In hop 3, passage 'Life Is a Dream (opera)' states it is 'a three-act opera...based on the 1635 play Life Is a Dream by Spanish playwright Pedro Calderón de la Barca.' This is an opera based on Spanish source material, with a clear act count (three acts). However, the trace does not show any solver analysis of hop 3 results, and the final concatenated output provides no verdict despite this potentially relevant evidence being retrieved.
